lane: chromium-counts (GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm), target original and rewrite
rule: The signed class of a type is its worst class (deterministic < stable < quarantined) over the workflow runs listed per profile and arm (original = A, rewrite = R); a type missing from a run counts as quarantined there; fewer than 3 workflow runs, a repeated run id or more than one image digest are refused. Each workflow run classifies its jobs (separate VMs) with fwcore measure.classify (re-derived from the run's counts files and equal to its classes artifact); the worst class, k and t (maxima over the workflow runs) and tBound (pixel types, the smallest over the workflow runs) come from fwcore measure.freeze (Lean Fw.Measure.Freeze), written by src/freeze.mjs; role (gate, finding, byDesign) and crossArm (cross-arm level, role and gate list; an arm without the type reads as deterministic) come from Lean Fw.Measure.Arms (measure.freeze rows, measure.arms). pooledClass is the class over all 9 counts files at once (a stricter cross-check, not the signed class).

pixelRule.appliesTo: types whose name ends in AreaPx
